title: Gandikota DTMC
description: Gandikota DTMC — an A-frame inspired eco-retreat that blends adventure architecture with the rugged charm of Gandikota’s landscape
notes: Gandikota DTMC (Destination Tourism Management Centre) is envisioned as a lightweight, elevated A-frame structure that harmonizes with the dramatic terrain of the Gandikota valley. The design draws from the spirit of exploration — angular roof forms, floating decks, and steel supports create a sense of openness and suspension over the earth. The structure minimizes its footprint while maximizing views, ventilation, and natural light. With its modern yet contextual design, Gandikota DTMC stands as an architectural response to nature — sustainable, experiential, and deeply rooted in the adventure tourism identity of the region.
